title: Summing multiplicities over a covering set
statement:
Let $m$ be a finite multiset with elements drawn from a type $\alpha$, and let $s$ be a finite set of elements of $\alpha$ that contains every element occurring in $m$. Writing $\mathrm{count}_m(a)$ for the multiplicity of $a$ in $m$, the multiplicities over $s$ sum to the total size of the multiset:
\[
  \sum_{a \in s} \mathrm{count}_m(a) = \abs{m}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: m is a multiset over α
every element of m belongs to s
replaced:
If every element of a multiset $m$ lies in the finite set $s$, then
\[
  \sum_{a \in s} \mathrm{count}_m(a) = \abs{m} .
\]
